facts.en: Earned a sound-production diploma at Fictional Echoheath College in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构回声荒原学院获得声音制作文凭。

facts.en: Paid assistant audio editor at Fictional Hollowbell Audio from 2019-09 to 2022-01.
facts.zh: 2019-09 至 2022-01 在虚构空铃音频公司任有薪助理音频编辑。

facts.en: Paid dialogue editor at Fictional Storyloom Recordings from 2022-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2026-08 在虚构故事织机录音公司任有薪对白编辑。

facts.en: Edits narration takes in Reaper against the approved script and producer’s marked selections.
facts.zh: 在 Reaper 中依据获批脚本及制作人标注的选段编辑旁白录音。

facts.en: Removes unwanted clicks, adjusts edits around breaths and flags uncertain words for producer review.
facts.zh: 去除不需要的咔嗒声，调整呼吸声附近的剪辑，并标记不确定词语供制作人审核。

facts.en: Maintains a pickup list with chapter, timecode and the reason a replacement recording is requested.
facts.zh: 维护补录清单，记录章节、时间码及请求替换录音的原因。

facts.en: A separate mastering engineer sets final delivery levels and exports the distribution master.
facts.zh: 另一名母带工程师设置最终交付电平，并导出发行母带。

facts.en: Edited assigned narration chapters on a 2025-08 team audiobook project.
facts.zh: 在 2025-08 团队有声书项目中编辑分配到的旁白章节。

facts.en: The candidate’s assigned chapters totalled 7.5 hours in the approved final programme, drawn from 13 hours of raw takes.
facts.zh: 候选人获分配章节在获批最终节目中共计 7.5 小时，素材来自 13 小时原始录音。

facts.en: The source does not give the candidate’s labour hours or the full audiobook’s duration.
facts.zh: 资料未提供候选人工时或整部有声书时长。

facts.en: Personally maintained edit markers and the pickup list; the producer directed narrator retakes.
facts.zh: 个人维护剪辑标记及补录清单；制作人指导朗读者重录。

facts.en: Uses Reaper, timecoded review notes and a versioned audio-file naming convention.
facts.zh: 使用 Reaper、带时间码的审核记录及带版本号的音频文件命名规范。

facts.en: Checks edited chapter order against the delivery checklist and supplies review exports to the producer.
facts.zh: 依据交付核对表检查已编辑章节顺序，并向制作人提供审核导出文件。

facts.en: Completed an internal dialogue-cleanup workshop in 2023-05 using practice audio.
facts.zh: 2023-05 使用练习音频完成内部对白清理工作坊。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Rustlereel Story Club from 2017-10 to 2019-06, arranging rehearsal schedules.
facts.zh: 2017-10 至 2019-06 在虚构沙沙卷故事社做志愿者，安排排练日程。

facts.en: For that club, assembled a noncommercial 18-minute audio story in 2020 with 3 friends.
facts.zh: 2020 年为该社与 3 名朋友共同制作一部非商业 18 分钟音频故事。

facts.en: Personally edited dialogue; the friends performed voices and supplied original background music.
facts.zh: 个人编辑对白；朋友们配音并提供原创背景音乐。

facts.en: The club story was shared at a private listening evening, with no sales or audience-download figures recorded.
facts.zh: 该社故事在私人试听晚会上分享，未记录销售或听众下载数据。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting imagined sound-effect ideas in a notebook and playing a small hand drum.
facts.zh: 爱好在笔记本中收集想象中的音效点子，以及演奏小手鼓。

facts.en: Keeps unresolved pronunciation questions separate from confirmed edits in production handovers.
facts.zh: 在制作交接中将未解决发音问题与已确认剪辑分开记录。
